description: Native modal or non-modal dialog; showModal() renders it in the top layer with the page behind made inert. The default modal for plain HTML sites.
a11y_notes: Baseline widely available (2022). showModal(): background inert, aria-modal implied, Esc closes, focus moves inside and returns to the trigger on close. Always include a visible close button and a label. Page scroll is not locked (html:has(dialog[open]) {overflow:hidden}). Click-outside dismiss via closedby="any" is Chrome 134+/Firefox 141+ only (not Safari yet): add a backdrop click handler if you need it.

description: Any element becomes a top-layer popover with light dismiss, toggled declaratively by a button's popovertarget; no z-index or JS needed for menus and panels.
a11y_notes: Baseline 2024. Not modal: no focus trap, so it suits menus, pickers and toggletips, not dialogs. Esc and click-outside close popover="auto"; the invoking button gets its expanded state exposed. Add role=menu only if you also build the menu keyboard pattern. popover="hint" is Chrome 151+/Firefox 153+ only (not Safari yet).

description: Native disclosure widget; <details> elements sharing a name attribute form an exclusive accordion (one open at a time). Right for FAQs and show-more sections.
a11y_notes: Summary is keyboard operable and announces expanded/collapsed. name (exclusive accordion) is Chrome 120+, Firefox 130+, Safari 17.2+. Don't put links or buttons inside <summary>. Animating open/close needs ::details-content plus interpolate-size, which not all browsers support: treat it as enhancement.

description: Native select; with appearance: base-select the button and picker become fully stylable (icons, rich options) while keeping native behaviour.
a11y_notes: Keyboard, type-ahead and screen-reader support come from the platform. Customizable select (appearance: base-select) is Chrome/Edge 135+ and Safari 27+, not Firefox; other browsers show a normal select, so it is safe progressive enhancement. For search-inside or multi-select with chips, use a combobox library.

description: Native date field with the platform's localized calendar picker; enough for single dates such as bookings or birthdays when brand styling of the calendar isn't needed.
a11y_notes: Keyboard and screen-reader support from the platform; value is always YYYY-MM-DD. The picker UI differs per browser and can't be styled. No range selection, no per-day availability or disabled days beyond min/max/step: use a date-picker library for those.

description: Native single-thumb slider for a numeric value; pair with <output> to show it.
usage: <label for="vol">Volume</label><input type="range" id="vol" min="0" max="100" value="50"><output for="vol">50</output>
a11y_notes: Arrow/Page/Home/End keys and slider semantics are built in. Always give it a label and show the value. Styling the thumb/track needs ::-webkit-slider-thumb and ::-moz-range-thumb. One thumb only: a two-thumb price range needs a library.

description: Suggestion list attached to a text input (combobox-lite); users may still type any value. Fine for optional hints on internal or low-stakes forms.
a11y_notes: Not Baseline (limited availability). The popup can't be styled, its text doesn't zoom with the page, and some screen-reader/browser pairs (NVDA + Firefox) don't announce it. Not a <select> replacement; for filtering, async results or rich options use an accessible combobox library.

description: <progress> shows task completion (indeterminate without a value); <meter> shows a scalar within a known range (storage used, score, strength).
a11y_notes: Implicit progressbar/meter roles; label them. Indeterminate progress has no value attribute. Styling needs vendor pseudo-elements (::-webkit-progress-value, ::-moz-progress-bar). Don't use <meter> for task progress.

description: Popover tethered to its trigger with CSS anchor positioning (anchor-name, position-anchor, position-area, position-try-fallbacks); no positioning library.
a11y_notes: Anchor positioning is Chrome/Edge 125+, Safari 26+ and Firefox 147+ with partial gaps: wrap it in @supports (anchor-name: --a) and give a fallback position. A hover tooltip must also open on focus, stay while hovered and close on Esc (WCAG 1.4.13); prefer a click toggletip for essential information and never hide the only label in a tooltip.

description: Wraps a search or filter form and exposes it as a search landmark for screen-reader navigation.
a11y_notes: Implicit role=search. Chrome 118+, Firefox 118+, Safari 17+; older browsers treat it as a generic element (add role="search" if they matter). Still label the input; a placeholder is not a label.

description: Built-in validation from required, type, min/max, pattern plus checkValidity(), validity and setCustomValidity(); style errors with :user-invalid.
usage: + CSS: input:user-invalid { border-color: var(--color-danger); }
a11y_notes: Native error bubbles are brief and inconsistently announced: for accessible errors use novalidate, read input.validity on submit, write messages into text linked by aria-describedby, set aria-invalid and focus the first invalid field. :user-invalid is Chrome 119+, Firefox 88+, Safari 16.5+.
